newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms names head of music unit.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms names head of music unit.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc's domestic cable unit, TCI Communications Inc, said on Wednesday John Reardon was named chief executive of its recently announced TCI music subsidiary.
Reardon, most recently president of his own international television consulting company, will report to Brendan Clouston, chief executive of TCI Communications.
TCI formed its new music subsidiary when it announced its recent proposal to acquire DMX Inc, which is being considered by DMX's board.
"Creating a company to manage the distribution of music to our cusomers is the logical next step after our proposal to the board to acquire DMX," Clouston said in a statement.
He said TCI will be able to help companies in the music industry expose products to TCI customers when digital distribution technology emerges.
Reardon was president of Viacom Inc's MTV:Music Television and was chief executive of ZING Systems, an interactive television company.
